VBO:0200375.summary: Sensitive and affectionate, the Collie tends to seek human company and responds readily to learning. Its Scottish herding heritage lives on in an alert watchdog manner, a fondness for play and participation in obedience, agility and herding trials. The long-coated Rough and short-coated Smooth varieties share this character and differ in coat.
VBO:0200375.shortDescription: A sensitive, affectionate companion with a herding heritage, the Collie includes both Rough and Smooth coats.

sources.title: Collie Club of America — Collie Standard
sources.evidence: Actual whole General Appearance, Head, Eyes, Ears, Neck, Body, Legs, Gait, Tail, Coat, Color, Size and Smooth paragraphs read. Combined standard applies to both varieties except coat; 1977 approval/current2025 publication. Full low natural tail and mature proportions normative.

sources.title: Collie Club of America — Collie Character
sources.evidence: Actual two full character paragraphs read: affection, sensitivity, human company, eagerness/quick learning, Scottish herding heritage, watchdog bark, play/retrieving/walks, obedience/agility/herding trials. Individual suitability guarantees and all-ages claims omitted.

sources.title: Collie Club of America — Rough & Smooth Varieties
sources.evidence: Actual entire paragraph explicitly two varieties identical except coat. Live primary mature Rough-and-Smooth adult group photograph viewed in browser; head/ear and coat comparison observed. Feet and tails absent from current view, controlled by normative standard.
